abstract_role: A field defined at every point of the medium (scalar, vector, tensor, or unit-vector).
evidence: S1 eta, S2 u, S3 delta p, S4 E and B, S5 m, S6 {n,v,B,p}.

abstract_role: A local coupling mechanism between adjacent infinitesimal regions (pressure, traction, curl, exchange, electromagnetic force).
evidence: All six systems supply a specific neighbour-coupling mechanism.

abstract_role: A locally transferred quantity that propagates between neighbours (pressure, traction, field, spin angular momentum, force density).
evidence: All six systems identify what flows locally between regions.

abstract_role: Something that pulls the disturbed state back toward equilibrium (gravity, elasticity, compressibility, anisotropy, magnetic tension, electrostatics).
pbuf_compatibility_summary: ABSENT in EM (S4). Present in S1, S2, S3, S5, S6.
evidence: EM in vacuum has no restoring mechanism; its propagation comes from curl coupling between E and B.

abstract_role: Something that resists the change of state (mass density, gyromagnetic precession, ion mass).
pbuf_compatibility_summary: ABSENT in EM (S4). Present in S1, S2, S3, S5, S6.
evidence: EM has no inertia; all mechanical systems have either classical mass or gyroscopic response.

abstract_role: A propagation speed determined by the ratio of restoring strength to resistance (mechanical) or by the coupling constants (EM).
evidence: c^2 ~ restoring / resistance (S1, S2, S3, S5, S6); c^2 = 1/(epsilon_0 mu_0) (S4).

abstract_role: Spatial variation of the medium parameters bends the wavefront (Snell's-law form).
evidence: All six systems identify a local steering mechanism.

abstract_role: A hyperbolic PDE (or coupled first-order system) admitting real characteristics at finite speed.
pbuf_compatibility_summary: derived after restoring + resistance (S1,S2,S3,S5,S6); derived after curl coupling (S4).
evidence: Two distinct routes to a wave equation: (a) restoring + resistance = second-order wave equation; (b) first-order curl coupling with no restoring, no resistance.
